Question: Why is the RAM called random access memory?
Answer: It was a mistake. Actually RAM should have been called as Read Write Memory (RWM). This is like West Indies was found by Columbus. Columbus was in a journey to find sea route to India. But he landed in a place where people were looking like Indians. So he thought he discovered India. Later wher they realised India is on East, the Britishers called that as West Indies and actual as Easy India. Actually there is only one India. There is nothing called West Indies. They new how to coverup their mistake. The same way when Engineers were trying to find a solution to overcome the Sequential Access Memory memories Access issue, they invented a Solid State Electronic Memory. In this Solid State Electronic Memory the Random Access was possible. Now let us discuss about the difference between Sequential Access Memory and Random Access Memory. First let us discuss about Sequential Access Memory. In a tape if there are 10 songs, if I ask you how much time it will take for me to go to 9th song? You can not answer it correctly. Because of you are in 1st song it will take more time, if you are in 4th song, it will take less time, if you are in 8th song it will take lesser time. Unless I tell you the current position, you can not tell me the correct time. Now we discuss about Random Access Memory. In this memory, irrespective of the current position it will take same fixed time to go to new position. So if you choose any Random position, it will take same time to access that location. Now let us continue our previous discussion, when the engineers invented Solid State Electronic Memory, the Random Access was possible, so they called this memory as Random Access Memory. So Engineers called this memory as RAM. This Memory has the following features. So Engineers were once again tried to find a memory which is Non-volatile. Actually our Board, Note Book, Magnetic Tape and Magnetic Disk are Non-volatile memory only. But Engineers were trying to find Non-volatile Solid State Electronics Random Access Memory. Unfortunately when they invented the Non-volatile Random Access Memory, they couldn't not write into it. That's why they called this as Read Only Memory (ROM). Actually these electronic memories should be called as follows. Read Write Random Access Memory Read Only Random Access Memory. But, initially Engineers called the Read Write Random Access Memory as RAM, world wide all documents were written as RAM. Changing all the documents is big task. So Engineers kept the RAM name for Random Access Read Write Memory and ROM for Random Access Read Only Memory. So both RAM (RWM) and ROM are Random Access Memory only. This is like LCD TV and LED TV. Both the TVs are LCD TV only. There is nothing called as LED TV. CCFL backlight LCD TV is called as LCD TV LED. backlight. LCD TV is called as LED TV. So when the RAM specified by mobile phone and Computer manufacturers are actually RWM (Read Write Memory) or Random Access Read Write Memory. I hope it is clear.
